items.title: Russia Bars Self-Custody Withdrawals From Regulated Crypto Accounts
items.summary: A separate restriction on direct crypto trades between individuals takes effect July 1, 2027, requiring residents to use authorized intermediaries.

items.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
items.summary: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

items.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
items.summary: The first major integration since Mastercard’s $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic commerce support planned.

items.title: CleanSpark and BitFuFu see bitcoin production slip in September as Canaan remains flat
items.summary: CleanSpark is ending monthly mining reports, while BitFuFu faces uncertainty over its Ethiopia deal.
